name: Careerstack
tagline: Plan the career. Skip the guesswork.
promise: Concrete, honestly-sourced guides to careers, skills, and certifications — real steps, real timelines, real salary data from official sources, and honest verdicts on which credentials are actually worth your money.
editorialPolicyHtml:
Every guide on Careerstack is built to be concrete and honest — the steps are ordered and realistic, the timelines are the ones people actually experience, and the costs are the real numbers, not marketing figures.

Salary data comes from official sources. We cite the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Occupational Outlook Handbook and name the exact occupation code, the wage figure, and the date the data is from. We never invent a number, and we tell you when an official category doesn't exist for a job title so you can judge the data for yourself.

Our "best certification" and "is it worth it" articles are honest. We give a real verdict with pros and cons, and we always say who a credential is not for. When we earn an affiliate commission from a course or certification we recommend, it never changes the ranking or the verdict — the best pick is the best pick, and the honest "skip it" stays a "skip it."

Dates are honest. Publish and update dates reflect real changes to the content. We do not bump a date without revising the article. When exam prices, requirements, or official data change, we update the guide or retire it — we don't leave stale numbers online.

About authorship: this is an early build of Careerstack, published under our editorial team while we grow. Before any wide launch, our career and certification guides will carry named authors with verifiable expertise in the field they write about (E-E-A-T).
